We got many templates but none obviously Friedel-Crafts acylation. Need to find one where retro_smarts_template corresponds to breaking aryl-halide and forming ketone. Look through results: first entry reaction_id 1037422 has retro_smarts_template: '[#7:7]-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:2])-[c;H0;D3;+0:1]...>>Cl-C(-Cl)(-Cl)-[C... etc' That seems like amide formation? Not.

Second entry reaction_id 1258606: retro_smarts_template: '[c:2]:[cH;D2;+0:1]:[c:3]>>C-O-C(=O)-C-C-[c;H0;D3;+0:1]...' Not.

Third entry reaction_id 953818: retro_smarts_template: '[C:2]-[c;H0;D3;+0:1]...>>Br-c1... etc' This shows a bromine aryl halide on left side of forward? The retro template shows product side is a brominated aryl? Actually retro_smarts_template: '[C:2]-[c;H0;D3;+0:1](:[cH;D2;+0:3]:[c:4]):[cH;D2;+0:5]:[c:6]>>Br-c1:c:c:c(-N-c2:n:c(-N-c3:c:c:[c;H0;D3;+0:1](-[C:2]):c:c:3-O-C):n:c:c:2-C(-F)(-F)-F):c(-C(=O)-N-C):n:1.C-C-O-P...' This seems like a transformation where a carbon attached to aromatic is broken to give a brominated aryl (aryl bromide) and some other fragment. That looks like Friedel-Crafts acylation? The product side (right side) is a brominated aryl with substituents. The left side (reactant) is a carbon attached to aromatic (maybe acylated). So this could be the template we need.

We need mapped_rxn and template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The result includes 'template_hash' and 'retro_smarts_template', but we need template_id. The search result likely includes 'template_id' field? Not shown. It includes 'reaction_id', 'template_hash', etc. The template_id may be same as reaction_id? Usually template_id is separate. But maybe we can use 'reaction_id' as template_id? The problem statement: "Return a dict with the `mapped_rxn` as a string and the `template_id` (the one used to search the database not the hash) as an integer". So template_id likely is the integer ID of the template, maybe same as 'reaction_id'? In earlier tasks, they used template_id as integer. So we can use reaction_id as template_id.

Thus choose the entry that matches Friedel-Crafts acylation. The entry 953818 seems plausible: it breaks a C-C bond between aromatic and carbonyl? Actually the left side is [C:2]-[c...] which is a carbon attached to aromatic (maybe carbonyl carbon). The right side includes Br-c1... which is aryl bromide. So yes.

Thus we will return mapped_rxn from that entry and template_id = 953818.
